title: DataArchetypeArchetypeContribution
description: Confidence-weighted archetype match asserting that a previously-identified data shape (DTO, entity, schema record) candidate; maps to GSM Archetype primitive in the data-shape role matches a known DataArchetype archetype catalog entry. Emitted by DataArchetypeArchetypingKs by reading the upstream DataArchetypeIdentity slot and the in-memory SourcerContext. Carries a confidence envelope (score < 1.0 by construction) and a provenance envelope (producing KS, indexed revision, tool versions, rule snapshot sha, seeds) for full reproducibility.

subject.description: Canonical reference to the candidate subject. For code-anchored subjects (Structure, Mechanism, DataArchetype, Effector, Receptor) this is typically a SCIP symbol moniker. For Interaction this is a stable composite key over the two endpoint subject references.

evidence.description: Optional explainability fragments (SCIP occurrence ranges, framework annotation hits, dataflow path summaries, IaC resource refs, etc.). Pure references; raw deterministic graphs are NOT persisted here.
